Abyssals: applied growth balance

14 October 2026 · Browser and PWA v0.61.0 · 478 reviewed, 98 growth spreads changed, 75 investment rewards.

These are the new game values, with the original authored percentages alongside for proof-checking. Existing earned stats, growth seeds and result cards remain unchanged; future level-ups use these rates. New generated partners use them for their simulated growth history.

478 shown

What changed

Scarimp and Grimscar have stronger Speed growth; Noctafey keeps mixed offence. Ruffurn’s line prioritises Attack without stripping its contact-survival HP or Defence. Calibrit’s line prioritises Special Attack, including Axiomaro’s armoured final form. Tank, healer, physical, special, mixed and utility archetypes were reviewed against all available ability slots and learned damaging moves. The original 187 ability slots and learnsets remain unchanged. All 175 approved additions use their own authored growth spreads without rarity bonuses.

Redistributions preserve each original total; additional growth rewards increase that budget by approximately 5–18%, depending on evidence of rarity and development cost. These are relative total-budget increases, not 5–18 percentage points added to every stat.

  • Legendary Watchers and Mythics: about 15%; Box Legendaries: about 18%.
  • Pseudo lines: about 8% / 10% / 15% across base, middle and final stages.
  • Fossil lines: about 6% / 8% / 10%; authored rare single-stage forms: about 8%.
  • Late evolution (level 36+): at least 8%; long development to the next evolution (level 28+) or formerly item-gated evolved forms: at least 5%.
  • Overlapping qualifications use the strongest reward, not stacked rewards. Points go to the form’s archetype strengths.

A rate crossing 100% resets the fractional bonus chance. Where that would accidentally lower average growth, the extra points were moved to another archetype strength. This preserves the existing growth algorithm and total reward budget.

How to read percentages

55% gives a 55% first chance of one increment, then an 11% conditional bonus roll after success. Before the all-zero safeguard: 45% no gain / 48.95% one increment / 6.05% two. 120% gives one guaranteed increment, a 20% chance of another, then a 4% conditional bonus roll. Exact 200% gives two guaranteed increments.

An increment is +10 HP or +1 other stat. If all six stats miss, one weighted stat rises. Totals add the six rates and are not probabilities; equal totals do not guarantee equal battle strength. Speed changes turn order, while moves and abilities set critical chance. Level 200 ends growth.

Sprite pass

Reviewed IDs 070–099 against a dark background. Repaired 070 Cairant’s incomplete crop, 071 Serapine’s foreign sprite fragments, and 072 Pandemne’s clipped outline using identity-preserving image edits. Repaired assets have alpha transparency and padded framing. The menu now reuses the battle sprite framing, so whitespace-heavy sprites such as 094 Sundune also display at a consistent size.

Source evidence: runtime species, growth workbook provenance, evolution conditions, ability descriptions, learnsets and sprites. Every species has a recorded archetype and explanation. These changes are a tested balance pass, not a claim of comprehensive late-game combat balance; the present playable slice does not exercise every late-game encounter.
